description: Umbrella fixture for the #506 current-state wave. It proves the intended broker, runner, plugin, and finalizer boundaries through injected source fixtures only.

requiredAssertions: sourceOnlyDecision=true
workerDispatchAllowedByThisPacket=false
finalizerRequired=true
team1-or-hybrid-execute-mode requires durable work-mode decision evidence
solo decision blocks Team1/hybrid helper execution
phases.expectedOutput: dispatch-gating evidence only; no task write

requiredAssertions: readOnlyValidation implies allowNoChanges
status=no_changes_allowed is classified as no-change evidence
openclaw_no_changes=allowed is classified as no-change evidence
read-only no-change lanes do not require PR creation
incidental PR URLs are ignored when no-change markers are present
phases.expectedOutput: PR-less Done/Block evidence classification from clean main fixture

requiredAssertions: brokerProtocolProfile survives monitor status projection
brokerBuildInfo coexists with brokerProtocolProfile
Hermes runtimeFlavor and gatewayRequired are sanitized before display
provider accepted or message-id evidence is not terminal ACK evidence
evidence-only cross-broker projection rows do not notify or ACK
operator-facing rows notify once and advance the cursor
one finalizer owns the closeout decision
worker outputs are evidence packets, not merge or close authority
finalizer matrix lists repo, lane, evidence, risk, decision, and next action
Wiki or runbook follow-up is explicitly classified

owningRepoGaps.gap: Work-mode decision evidence is not yet mandatory and durable across Team1/hybrid paths.
Read-only/no-change evidence classification needs a clean-main smoke fixture.
Requester-visible status projection needs a no-live fixture tied to broker evidence hints.

outOfScopeRepos.reason: independent repository; not an A2A no-live smoke lane or A2A owning-repo gap
